'''Tim Guzman Gen-Con 99' (tournament report)''' is [[Tim Guzman]]'s report on [[1999 GenCon Open]] and the Gen Con 1999 side events. He published it on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as The Information Broker.<ref name="or-gen">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/GenCon99.htm Gen-Con 99'], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030141408/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/GenCon99.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 17th of 151 at 8 (+81) in the Open. [[Chris Hines]] finished 14th at 5–1. [[Patrick Hines]] finished 1–5.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Tim Guzman]] (byline: The Information Broker)
* '''Published:''' [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]
* '''Report title:''' ''Gen-Con 99'''
* '''Event:''' [[1999 GenCon Open]]
* '''Event date:''' 7 August 1999 (the convention ran 5–8 August 1999)
* '''Players:''' 151 (Open)
* '''Finish:''' 17th (Open)
* '''Record:''' 4–2
* '''Points:''' 8 (+81)

== Other results named in the report ==

* Open 14th [[Chris Hines]] 5–1
* Open 17th [[Tim Guzman]] 4–2, 8 (+81)
* Open [[Patrick Hines]] 1–5
* Three players went undefeated in the Open. Guzman wrote that he heard the final was between [[Nathan Reisch]] and [[Joe Mornout]]
* [[1999 GenCon OTSD Booster Draft]]: Guzman 3–0, about 4th
* [[1999 GenCon EPP Overdrive]]: [[Chris Hines]] about 8th
* [[1999 GenCon Endor Draft]]: 50-player cap; [[Patrick Hines]] was not selected; Guzman dropped after a first-game loss; [[Chris Hines]] stayed
* [[1999 GenCon Team Event]]: Guzman, Chris Hines, and Patrick Hines did not play

== Side event ==

Thursday Young Jedi Sealed is named in the report and stays on the archived HTML. [[Patrick Hines]] went 3–0 and finished 5th in that Young Jedi event.

== Discrepancies ==

* The Open hub records 152 players from DeckTech reports. Guzman wrote 151.
* The Open hub already records [[Nathan Reisch]] 1st and [[Joe Mornout]] 2nd from Decipher Deck Designs. Guzman's report gives those names as hearsay with Mornout spelled Mornout(sp?).

== Original report ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: GEN-CON 99'

 Now, How do you start a report on
 something that took 4 days? Well, I could start by saying that it was a major
 upset during the Open when I didn't come in first, but I am still wondering
 if it really was an upset or not. Ok thats a joke of course, but having a great
 time at the Con is not. This was big and Decipher was busy. They had one tournament
 after another. Which could keep people like me pretty busy. So if you are in
 the mood to read then I will Start with Day 1. Now if all you care about is
 the OPEN then skip to day 3.

 Day 1

 Thursday it all starts. It was myself(Tim Guzman), Pat Hines, Chris Hines and
 his wife Sheri, who went to Gen-Con. We picked up are badges and we were ready
 to go. The first tournament of the day was a Young Jedi Sealed Deck, which started
 at 12:00 PM. So we had plenty of time to look around and get the feeling of
 our surroundings. We went to the Decipher booth first to say hi to Kendrick
 and Sean and some other Decipher folks. We knew Kyle was running the tournament
 so we had to look for him. When we found him he was ready for Young Jedi and
 we wanted to still look around. Now the details could take a lot of time to
 write out so I will keep things short to the best of my abilities. Beside most
 of you only care about how we did in the tournaments, right?

 This was the day we decided to call tournament day. Because the other 3 days
 we didn't want to play in many tournaments. Anyway Pat and I registered for
 one Young Jedi tournament and two Star Wars tournaments for this day. Chris
 only registered for the later two Star Wars tournaments. Pat went undefeated
 in the Younag Jedi Sealed deck and I lost one game in that one. I was Jedi and
 Pat was Sith. Even though he went 3-0 he was in 5th place. The next tournament
 was an OTSD. Now in this one it was my turn to go 3-0 and Chris and Pat both
 lost one game I think...maybe two for Pat but I can't seem to remember. I came
 in like 4th place because of so many people playing in it. Now it is about 9:00
 PM and we are all tired because of such crazy flights to get here in the first
 place. We have one more tournament to play in today. It is a Endor Booster Draft
 tournament. They only let 50 people play in the event and they just choose names
 randomly. Which left Pat without playing. We were a little upset about that.
 First place prize was a set of foils so I was going to play to try to win it.
 Anyway I lost my first game so bad that I drop out of the tournament. Since
 I didn't have a chance for the set of foils and Pat wasn't playing anyway I
 really didn't want to play. Chris stayed and played however and Pat and I went
 back to the Hotel to rest for the next day.

 Day 2

 Friday ah...a new day. We eat breadfast at Denny's and head over to the Con.
 This day we didn't want to stay that long since only tomorrow was the Open and
 we wanted to play test tonight. So we played in the EPP overdrive tournament
 this day at 12:00 PM. I was light and glad, Chris was Dark and Pat was Light.
 I was doing good this tournament, but all of the sudden I play a guy with two
 Vader's in his sealed deck, plus he Limited Resouced me twice in this Game.
 Wow he has got some good draws for this being Sealed deck. Chris finished the
 highest in this one at around 8th Place. After this tournament we go up to the
 exhibit hall and mess around demoing different games. We tried games called
 Apples to Apples, 7th Sea, and many others. Not to mention spending money here
 and there. We ate at some Brewery that night before we headed back to the hotel.
 When we go back to the hotel we used a meeting room there and play tested are
 decks to about 3:00 AM. We made some of our last minute changes and was ready
 to go.

 Day 3

 This is the big day, the day we were preparing for. I was quite confident of
 my decks and so was Chris. The only problem was we only had less than 5 hours
 sleep. But that is ok, I kept telling myself I play better this way. The tournament
 starts at 10:00 AM. So we showed up around 9:30 and waited until that time.
 The following will be a tournament report based off of my games that I played
 I will mention how Chris and Pat did along the way. I will not give away my
 decks YET. but keep checking back at this site and I will post them very soon.
 Decipher broke a record here with 151 players. So this was big.

 Game 1 My Dark Vs Joey's Light side Asteroid Sanctuary Deck.

 He started with mind what you have learned and played major Sanctuary Cheese.
 I was worried at first because I wasn't really ready for this deck. I thought
 for sure I was going to get crushed. I tried to alter but I had to add 4 so
 it didn't work the first time. I deployed Reactor Terminal and started putting
 0 and 1's in my used pile and when I had it right I altered all effects and
 killed his ships with my ships. In the end he couldn't keep up with the force
 loss I was giving him. So I win.

 Full Win by 27

 Highlights: Was beating a deck I wasn't planning on seeing by 27.

 Lowlights: Was Playing against a Sanctuary Deck...I hate those decks.

 Game 2 My Light Vs Chris Hines Dark Power deck.

 Well this really sucked, Chris and I played till like 3:00 AM... the night before
 and now we have to play each other in the second game. Anyway his dark deck
 will always beat my light deck on a consistent basis if he knows what's coming.
 And of course he knows what was coming so he won. I was hoping for a good draw
 and for him to have a bad draw. but no he had a great draw and started draining
 early. I couldn't stop it for the longest time. I decided that I just better
 keep it close.

 Full loss by 13

 Highlights:None except Chris won 2 in a row.

 Lowlights: I had to play Chris, which ruined my chance for worlds. I still think,
 if I didn't play him I would have made it to the final. Anyway...

 Game 3 My Light Vs Someone's Railtier Ops

 I was still a little upset by this time about playing Chris so I wanted to take
 out my revenge on this poor guy. I was very aggressive this game. Somehow he
 flips anyway and deploys a ship to kessel. he battles against my lone ship.
 So I react with Spiral. It is all down hill for him after that. I call it beat
 down from behind because he didn't see it coming. I had 11 cards in my hand
 and still won by 30. That was fun.

 Full win by 30

 Highlights:Dominated the game from the beginning

 Lowlights: Having 11 cards in my hand. I could have won by more.

 Game 4 My Dark Vs Nice Guys Kashyyyk Ops Deck.

 I was a little worried about this at first. You know some Ops are just hard
 to beat. But once I got started I was ok. My draw against him was great. Vader
 was down early with Saber and he couldn't kill him the whole game. Next thing
 you know he does a last ditch effort and deploys some lone guys at my sites
 to get some drains in. I was like what? I couldn't stop him for a couple of
 turns then finally I have something. As soon as that happens I win.

 Full Win by 27

 Highlights: Winning big against an Ops Deck. Those decks suck now I think.

 Lowlights: Winning aganinst someone who was such a nice guy. OH and drawing
 a zero and a 1 against an ability one guy.

 Game 5 My Dark Vs Eric Olsen's Hidden Base Deck.

 Things were going great when he said he just lost his hidden base to a force
 drain off the top of his reserve. I was punishing him the whole game. Vader
 had a drain that he couldn't stop the whole game. So now I have around 25 force
 left and he has around 10 force left. I think yes, yes, yes, I am going to win.
 Well guess what happens. He deploys 8D8 in front of Vader and Artoo the Inserts
 Never tell me the Odds. My chant changed to yuck, yuck, yuck. I tried to avoid
 the insert as long as possible I bring him done to only 4 force left, and think
 to myself if the insert doesn't come up juring his next force drain I might
 make it. Now his turn starts. He uses All Wings Report In and targets 7 x-wings
 and retrieve 7 force. Then he force drains me for 4 and his insert comes up
 as the 4 card is drained. I lose to that card and he wins. I had that game I
 should have done one thing different.

 Full loss by 11

 Highlights: Watching his Hidden base go to his Lost pile.

 Lowlights: Watching him insert a card toward the end of the game, when if it
 was the beginning I would have never drained away the cards that take care of
 that. Oh well...

 Game 6 My Light Vs Someone's Dark Space

 Well since I lost my last game my chance for a glass was gone. Chris just lost
 his last game as well but he still had a chance for top eight. I had control
 the whole game in this one, but it took awhile to finish this guy off(No pun).
 He always had something coming. I win in the end. I will keep this one short.

 Full Win by 21

 Highlights:I had control over the Death Star most of the game.

 Lowlights: I was starving by now and really tired from lack of sleep.

 Well I fineshed with a 4-2 record and going 8(+81). Out of 151 people I came
 in 17th Place. Chris goes 5-1 and comes in 14th place. And in the end there
 were 3 people who were Undefeated. To bad for the person who came in third place.
 Pat came in near the bottom with a 1-5 record, today just wasn't his day.

 The top decks were Mains and Toys mostly. Ops are dead, those who brought them
 wish they didn't. I don't really know what decks made the final since we didn't
 stick around to watch. but I heard that it was between Nathan reish and Joe
 Mornout(sp?).

 There was a Endor booster draft tonight but after 8+ hours of playing Star Wars
 we were tired. So we called it quits for the day. In fact we were so burnt out
 that we ditched the Team Event the next day. I know we promoted it all week
 and we don't even play in it. I will tell you why later.

 OH and during the Tournament Sheri was nice enough to take my Young Jedi 'Captain
 Panaka' Card and get it signed by the Actor. That was COOL. Thanks Sheri.:)

 Day 4

 Well if you made it this far Thank you. And if you are one of those who read
 the first 3 days and waited for Day 4, then here it is one week later!! Sometimes
 for some reason the last day of a Con is the best. Maybe it is because you do
 as much as you can in such a short period of time. I don't know the reason,
 but I so wish the Con was open longer on Sundays. But as it is we only had until
 4:00 PM. So we tryed one game after another. At one point there was this 'Spin
 the Wheel' game from WOTC. Chris and Pat got boring Coupons, but when I spinned
 the wheel I got three Booster packs and a Complete Card game called Guillotine.
 You win at this game by getting a head(Pun get it). We didn't play in the Team
 Event this day, because we knew we had decks that needed to be kept a secret
 for Comic-Con. So that was one of the reasons why we didn't play and thats why
 I said I would tell you later. Because Now officially Comic-Con is over. More
 on that in the Comic-Con report.

 Anyway as this day came to a close Chris and I chose which games we like the
 best not counting SWCCG. And thats what we played at the Airport. Now before
 we left Kendrick asked if I would help at the Decipher Booth in Comic-Con and
 of course I agreed. Chris did also. Well now it is the end of the day and we
 are sooo ready to go home. Guess what? Are flight is delayed by 4 hours. This
 gave us plenty of time to pratice at Doomtown CCG. But I think I would trade
 in a flight home for that. We didn't end up home until 3:00 AM. That was a late
 time for me....I had to work at 6:00 AM. Some how I made it through and that
 was my experience at this years Gen-Con. Can't wait for next years.

 The Information Broker
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
